title.en: An Act Adding a Proviso to Subsection (B) of Section Twelve of Act Numbered Seventeen Hundred and Ninety-One, Entitled "An Act to Amend in Certain Respects Act Numbered Eighty-Two, Known as the 'Municipal Code' " By Providing Tliat the Municipal Council May, in Its Discretion, Extend the Time for the Payment, Without Penalty, of Certain License Taxes.

text.en:
The following words are hereby added at the end of subsection (b) of section twelve of Act
Numbered Seventeen hundred and ninety-one:
"Provided, further, That the ten days extension of time for such payment, without penalty, may be extended
ten days further, in the discretion of each municipal council, for the following reasons: Bad condition of roads,
breaking of bridges, great "freshets, and other analogous circumstances."

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, May 20, 1909.
